claim.statement: GitHub's dated 2 June 2026 changelog says Copilot cloud agent automations can run on a schedule or in response to repository events, are scoped to one repository, and can be configured with tools such as creating pull requests or updating issue labels.

source.title: Schedule and automate tasks with Copilot cloud agent
source.locator: Opening paragraphs; scope paragraph; configurable fields list

limitations: This is a dated service announcement, not an independently observed automation run or immutable backend version.
Automation availability, triggers and tools are configuration-dependent and may change after capture.
unknowns: The effective trigger, creator, input trust boundary, selected tools, model and repository policy are unknown.
The code, pull requests, labels, comments or other external mutations produced by a particular automation are unknown.
